items.title: PoC released: CVE-2026-66917

items.priority_rationale: SSVC: total impact · Public PoC on GitHub · EPSS 0.5%

items.ai_summary: CVE-2026-66917 involves a combination of Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) and Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) stemming from broken object-level authorization in JoomGallery. items.why_it_matters: Website administrators running JoomGallery must update immediately to block potential stored XSS and data exposure.

items.title: PoC released: CVE-2026-10053
items.description: Reproducible lab for CVE-2026-10053 (GitLab npm package-registry path traversal -> arbitrary file write as git). Vulnerable 19.2.1 vs patched 19.2.2, deterministic oracle.
items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high
items.ai_summary: CVE-2026-10053 is a path traversal vulnerability within the npm package-registry component of GitLab version 19.2.1, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve arbitrary file writes running as the git user. A public proof-of-concept exploit has been released that utilizes a deterministic oracle to verify exploitation. Successful attacks can lead to system compromise and code execution within the repository context. Remediation requires updating GitLab immediately to version 19.2.2 or later.
items.why_it_matters: GitLab administrators must upgrade to version 19.2.2 immediately to prevent full system compromise via arbitrary file writes.

items.title: PoC released: CVE-2026-15718

items.cwe_name: CWE-763 Release of Invalid Pointer or Reference
items.priority_rationale: Public PoC on GitHub · EPSS 0.4% · CVSS 4.3
items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high
items.ai_summary: CVE-2026-15718 is a vulnerability in SpiderMonkey's wasm baseline compiler where an array.fill operation suffers from a missing-sync issue, producing an invalid pointer. This primitive allows attackers to construct arbitrary read and write capabilities, resulting in remote code execution. A proof-of-concept exploit chain has been published demonstrating the attack vector. Mitigating this issue requires applying vendor-supplied browser updates containing the corrected compiler logic.
items.why_it_matters: Browser operators and downstream developers must apply engine patches immediately to block active remote code execution exploitation chains.

items.title: CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog
items.description: CISA has added one new vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-73570 Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability This type of vulnerability is a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and poses significant risks to the federal enterprise.
